chat.name: answer-reserve
chat.usage: Local answer token reserve for --count-tokens or context shortening (not a generation limit)

chat.name: context-max-turns
chat.usage: With sliding-window, keep at most N recent user turns, including the current turn

chat.name: context-strategy
chat.usage: Conversation policy: strict (default), drop-oldest, sliding-window, or summarize (Local only; one extra model call)

chat.name: retry
chat.usage: Retry transient Local failures only; bare --retry means 3 extra attempts, --retry=N sets 0-5 (not --retry N); waits share --timeout

local_contract: local is explicit and independent of Shortcuts; streaming human text and HTTP SSE only; JSON/agent and batch outputs remain complete; complete usage is Apple-measured; context overflow fails by default; respond --messages and text chat can opt into disclosed context shortening without changing stored history; --retry applies only to final Local answers before output or tool activity, never extra summary calls
